title: Resolve a domain name using NSS
summary: Use the getent command to check how your system resolves a domain name through the Name Service Switch (NSS). This shows the IP address associated with the domain.
prerequisites: Know the domain name you want to resolve

steps.explain: Query the NSS hosts database for the specified domain name.

placeholders.name: DOMAIN_NAME
placeholders.description: The domain name to resolve, e.g., archlinux.org

steps.expect: The command outputs the IP address(es) associated with the domain.
